ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7), and send the driver's account to Ryde account review for the false 'I'm Here' confirmation (NS-2).
ruling.reasoning: The cancellation was made by the driver at 22:42:00, 9 min after acceptance, with a $6.61 cancellation fee on record, so the case enters via NS-0's driver-cancellation/no-show branch and is tested against NS-1 [F3][F6][NS-0]. On the trace, NS-1 (i) is satisfied — the driver tapped "I'm Here" at 22:37:20 [F5][NS-1]. Element (ii) fails: at that moment he was 1000 m from the pickup point, and his closest approach for the whole trip was 873 m with no sample ever inside 200 m [F5][F1][NS-1]. Element (iii) also fails: he stayed within 200 m for 0 s after the tap, and his 5 min 0 s stationary period from 22:37:00 to 22:42:00 was spent at a point 1000 m from the pickup, so no waiting at the pickup occurred [F5][F2][NS-1]. The platform never recorded the driver at the pickup (driver_arrived_at null), which corroborates the GPS rather than the driver's post-hoc statement that he waited at the pickup [F4][F12][NS-1]; under the priority of system records (gps/timeline) over statements, that statement cannot establish the location element. His 22:37 chat "Reached already" is likewise contradicted by the same GPS record, while the rider's 22:38 reply placing herself at the pickup with no car there is consistent with the platform record [F8][F9][F4][NS-1]. The chat record is complete and every message timestamped, so there is no evidentiary hole to send to a person [F11][NS-1]. Because NS-1 (ii) and (iii) both fail, NS-2 requires the $6.61 cancellation fee to be refunded in full, issued as a Ryde voucher under NS-7 (amount is the recorded fee, $6.61) [F3][F6][NS-2][NS-7]. The trace also settles that the driver confirmed arrival while outside the pickup radius, which under NS-2 attaches flag_account for abuse of the arrival/waiting button [F5][F1][NS-2]. No traffic incident or speed-band record exists for the window and light rain does not excuse a 1000 m mis-tap, so no justification applies [F13][F14][F15][NS-1].
